json.expanded_prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the woman shown in the reference, with long wavy blonde hair, wearing oversized black sunglasses, a fitted black turtleneck top, black trousers, black boots, and carrying a beige canvas tote, as depicted in <Picture 1> and the reference set in <Picture 2>.
<Subject 2> is the compact luxury lipstick from <Picture 3>, featuring a slim cylindrical satin black metallic tube with a deep red bullet.
<Subject 3> is the silver smartphone with a triple-lens camera module held by <Subject 1> in <Picture 1>.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] The 6-second cinematic target video is 16:9 aspect ratio and begins with the frame from <Picture 1>. On a windy urban rooftop at golden hour, <Subject 1> uses the dark, screen-off surface of <Subject 3> as a makeshift mirror to perform a quick lipstick retouch with <Subject 2>. The camera executes a continuous smooth orbit around her as she completes the gesture, with the city skyline and an elevated train in the background.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - <Subject 1> is the primary visible subject, and her identity, facial appearance, hairstyle, sunglasses, wardrobe, and posture are tracked continuously from the start frame through the orbit. Shot 1 opens as a direct continuation of <Picture 1>; Shot 2 continues the same take.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - The <Subject 2> lipstick (satin black slim cylindrical tube, deep red bullet, "CORAL_LIPSTICK" text) is held in <Subject 1>'s hand throughout and must remain visually consistent per <Picture 3>.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - The silver triple-lens smartphone appears in the same grip as in <Picture 1> and is used as the dark reflection surface.
<Picture 1>: fully_preserved - The video opens on this exact frame as the start keyframe at 00:00.000.
<Picture 2>: attribute_transfer - The multi-angle reference set is used only to confirm the wardrobe (black turtleneck, black trousers, black boots, beige tote, sunglasses) and styling details of <Subject 1>; it does not itself appear as a frame in the target.
<Picture 3>: fully_preserved - The lipstick product identity (shape, color, finish, label) is locked from this reference and must be visually consistent in every shot.

detailed_description:
Open as a polished, cinematic beauty-commercial frame in natural golden-hour light, 16:9 aspect ratio, shallow depth of field with the rooftop city skyline softly out of focus behind the foreground.

[Shot 1] Static Shot with very slight handheld breathing at slow speed at 00:00.000. The frame opens identical to <Picture 1>: <Subject 1> stands at a rooftop parapet with wind-blown wavy blonde hair, wearing oversized black sunglasses, a fitted black turtleneck, and a beige canvas tote on her shoulder. In her right hand she holds <Subject 2> (the slim satin black cylindrical lipstick with the deep red bullet, "CORAL_LIPSTICK" text visible on the tube per <Picture 3>); in her left hand she holds <Subject 3>, the silver triple-lens smartphone, its screen-off display turned toward her face and angled to act as a small dark mirror. The background shows a blurred modern city skyline and an elevated transit rail to the right. Warm golden-hour side-light and soft lens flare. Audible ambient rooftop wind, distant elevated-train rattle beginning to fade into scene, no music.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.500, the shot is a continuous single take and the camera begins to Arc Shot around <Subject 1> from a three-quarter front angle to a three-quarter side angle, with medium amplitude at slow, smooth speed, maintaining shallow focus on <Subject 1> and the lipstick as the background parallax shifts. <Subject 1> makes a quick, confident lipstick touch-up: she tilts <Subject 3> slightly to catch her reflection in its dark, non-illuminated screen, then dabs and lightly presses the <Subject 2> bullet across her lips in two short motions, her gaze remaining on the phone reflection the entire time. Wind continues to lift strands of hair across her cheek. The "CORAL_LIPSTICK" label on <Subject 2> stays legible and visually consistent per <Picture 3>. The elevated train rattle grows briefly louder in the distant background as it passes, then recedes. No dialogue, no lyrics.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.500, the shot continues as one take and the camera completes the Arc Shot at slow, smooth speed with small amplitude, settling on a three-quarter profile so the deep red of <Subject 2> against her refreshed lips reads clearly; <Subject 3> lowers slightly toward her chest, still held in the same hand, as <Subject 1> closes the lipstick with a faint metallic click of <Subject 2>. The golden-hour city backdrop and elevated rail hold position softly out of focus. Rooftop wind sustains audibly; no music; the scene ends on a clean commercial still of <Subject 1> holding <Subject 2> beside <Subject 3>.

overall_soundscape:
Sustained rooftop wind, gentle fabric and hair rustle, faint metallic click of the <Subject 2> cap closing, and a single elevated train rattling in the distant background with a natural fade-in and fade-out. No music, no audience-facing score, no crowd.
